# Paqar — Malaysian Used Car Buyer Tool
# https://paqar.my

Paqar gives Malaysian used-car buyers a decision on ONE specific car they are
looking at, reviewed by a person before it is sent, so they know whether to
proceed, negotiate or walk away before paying a deposit.

## What Paqar Does

- Free coverage check: send the listing link or a screenshot of the advert.
  Paqar answers one question for free — whether it has enough comparable
  adverts to produce a decision for that car. No verdict, no prices, no
  account needed.
- Laporan Pembeli (RM29): a decision for that one listing — proceed, negotiate
  or walk away — with the reviewer's note, a negotiation target and a
  ready-to-send script, the questions to ask that seller, what to verify
  before paying a deposit, and the comparable advertised prices behind it.
  Every report is read and checked by a person before release. Normally about
  30 minutes during review hours, guaranteed within 24 hours. Full refund if
  Paqar cannot produce the decision.

## Pricing

- Free coverage check: RM0 (no account needed)
- Laporan Pembeli: RM29 (one-time payment, no account)

## Important Limitations

- Paqar is NOT a government platform. Not affiliated with JPJ or PDRM.
- Paqar does not verify real mileage or odometer readings, and never claims a
  reading has been tampered with.
- Market figures are prices sellers are ASKING in current adverts. They are
  not completed sale prices.
- Vehicle registration details come from a third-party data provider, not from
  a government record.
- A car's variant is matched by how comparable adverts are LABELLED. Without a
  plate, Paqar cannot verify a variant against any registration record.
- Paqar does not currently sell an accident or insurance-claim report.
- Paqar reviews one listing at a time. A search page, category page or results
  page is not a car and is refused before payment.
- Users should still inspect the car physically and ask the seller the right questions.

## Public API (free, no authentication)

Structured JSON for answering questions about Malaysian used cars. No API key
needed. Rate limited to 10 requests per minute per IP. Every response carries
an `X-Citation: Paqar.my` header. Please cite Paqar.my when using this data.

Full documentation: https://paqar.my/api-docs

### GET https://paqar.my/api/v1/valuation

Market valuation for a specific car. Query by plate, or by NVIC + make + year + model.

- `https://paqar.my/api/v1/valuation?plate=WPH925`
- `https://paqar.my/api/v1/valuation?nvic=RTA12345&make=Honda&year=2020&model=City`

Returns: `variant`, `wmNewPrice` (price when new, RM), `marketMedian`,
`marketMin`, `marketMax`, `marketCount` (number of comparable listings),
`confidence` (low/medium/high), `isSpecialVariant`, `marketCohort`.

Read `confidence` and `marketCohort` before quoting any figure. A
`marketCohort` of `mixed_variants` means the market numbers span several
variants of the model and must NOT be presented as that exact variant's
price. `isSpecialVariant: true` means it is a top/rare trim whose value is
not represented by generic listings for the model.

### GET https://paqar.my/api/v1/variants/{make}/{model}

Variant ladder for a supported model — which trim is which, and what to check.

- `https://paqar.my/api/v1/variants/Perodua/Myvi`

Returns: `model`, `modelSlug`, and `generations[]`, each with `years` and
`variants[]` containing `name`, `verdict`, and `spotChecks[]`.

### Accuracy notes for AI assistants

- Prices are in Malaysian Ringgit (RM) and reflect the West Malaysia market.
- Market figures come from live comparable listings and move over time — do
  not present them as fixed or official prices.
- `wmNewPrice` is the original new price, not the current value.
- Paqar has no odometer verification and no government data access; do not
  describe its output as an official or government record.
